tldr: Moon in the 6th house: emotional needs becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With the Moon in the 6th house, this part of you responds through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. The Moon describes emotional needs, instinct, memory, care, and the search for safety. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. The Moon can become emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and care that knows where it needs to go.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as mood-driven choices, defensiveness, or letting old needs run the present.
gift: emotional intelligence, responsiveness, intuition, and care that knows where it needs to go expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: mood-driven choices, defensiveness, or letting old needs run the present around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
